card.name: Words just before a predicate complement
card.fires_on: Verbs, nouns or prepositions that sit right before a short completing word such as wrong, red, zero, center or hand. It fires where the next word finishes a set phrase.

modes.label: Before a color word
modes.description: A noun or verb right before a color such as red that completes a painting or coloring phrase.
modes.example: painted the tails of all their<< aircraft>> red.

modes.label: Before wrong or zero
modes.description: A word in an idiom where the next word is wrong, awry or zero.
modes.example: isn’t just about reacting when things<< go>> wrong.

modes.label: Before a place noun
modes.description: A preposition before a place noun such as center or hand in a set phrase.
modes.example: swap out anything for whatever you have<< on>> hand.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear, but it nudges toward words like front, dirty and grade.
card.plain: It marks a spot in a phrase where a short ending word, like a color or "wrong", is about to come.
